name: Kawazoe Honami
source:
A rich lady that recently check in hot spring. Is old fashion but kind especially to protagonist after he shows himself to be very reliable. 

[spoiler] After finding out where the protagonist use to work is distraught. Her husband who she is having problems with thus spending time away is responsible for company struggling thus indirectly responsible for his job loss among others. Is afraid he will hold it against her.  [/spoiler]
